dinemetric.title: Dinemetric
dinemetric.description: An AI-powered restaurant platform with menu recommendations and insights to support daily operations.
dinemetric.problem: Help restaurant teams turn operational data into actionable insights and AI-powered menu recommendations.
dinemetric.decision: Uses a typed oRPC client with request batching to connect the Next.js interface to application services.
dinemetric.contribution: Contributed to the team developing Dinemetric, an AI-powered restaurant management platform. The product connects restaurant workflows with operational insights and menu recommendations.
dinemetric.outcome: The platform gives restaurant teams a single place to access operational insights and AI-powered menu recommendations.

smilysis.title: Smilysis
smilysis.description: An application for tracking dental habits and progress with AI-powered scans and personalized insights.
smilysis.problem: Bring dental habits, scan-based insights, and oral-health progress into one tracking experience.
smilysis.decision: Uses a shared Supabase client with session persistence so sign-in state can be reused across the application.
smilysis.contribution: Contributed to the team developing Smilysis, a dental-health tracking application. The product brings together daily habits, scan-based insights, and personalized progress tracking.
smilysis.outcome: The application brings dental habits, scan-based insights, and oral-health progress into one experience.

sips.title: Sips Cafe
sips.description: A bubble tea ordering platform with menu browsing, payments, and administration tools.
sips.problem: Bring bubble tea ordering, payments, and day-to-day administration into one application.
sips.decision: Used ASP.NET Identity for authentication and authorization, with email verification and reCAPTCHA to support account security.
sips.contribution: Developed full-stack functionality with C#, ASP.NET Core, and Azure SQL. My work included authentication and authorization with ASP.NET Identity, email verification, reCAPTCHA, REST APIs, and relational database structures.
sips.outcome: The team built an ordering platform connecting menu browsing, PayPal checkout, and administration. The project provided hands-on experience integrating identity, APIs, and a relational database.
